_help: Where To Submit blog-comment settings. Lives next to profile.json in the workspace. Everything here stays on your machine; only the per-page status goes to wheretosubmit.org. Keys that start with _ are notes. Replace every TODO. Run scripts/preflight.mjs after editing.

identity._help: Typed into every comment form: name, email, website. Use one real, fixed identity per project. name is a person's name, not the product's. email is a mailbox you own on a normal provider (Gmail, Outlook, your own domain); disposable addresses get comments flagged. website is the product URL and becomes the link on your name.
identity.name: TODO: Jane Doe

pages._help: Pages of the product that a comment may link to. Deep pages (guides, blog posts, docs) work far better than the homepage. about is one honest line of what the page covers; the agent may not claim anything beyond it. topics is what kinds of posts the page fits.

items.about: TODO: one line, what the page covers

styleExamples._help: Three to five finished comments in the voice to match: one concrete fact per sentence, 250 to 400 characters, a specific observation first, the link as an aside at the end. Examples of tone and shape only; the agent never reuses them.

_linkInBody: always (default): one <a href> with descriptive anchor text in the body of every comment; the Website field is filled too when the form has one. when-no-website-field: link on the name only where a Website field exists, body link elsewhere. never: no body link at all.
_hrefBreak: true writes a body link with a line break before the closing quote of the href, which keeps some WordPress installs from adding rel=nofollow. Body links only. See references/comment-writing.md.
_usedAnchors: Anchor texts already used in body links, kept by the agent so no two comments share one.

run._help: count: pages per run, 1 to 25. pace: normal or careful; careful doubles the delays.
